sources.title: Banking_Queries_Classification.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: DistilBERT Sequence Classification - Industry Fine-tuned DistilBERT model by using Banking77 dataset. The dataset is composed of online banking queries annotated with their corresponding intents. BANKING77 dataset provides a very fine-grained set of intents in a banking domain. It comprises 13,083 customer service queries labeled with 77 intents.

sources.title: Dey-Koushik/banking77-intent-classifier - GitHub
sources.snippet: Banking77 Intent Classifier Fine-tuned DistilBERT that routes customer support messages into one of 77 banking intents, with a confidence threshold that escalates uncertain queries to human agents rather than guessing.

sources.title: Banking77 Dataset | fanolabs/NID_ACLARR2022 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview The Banking77 dataset is a financial domain intent classification dataset containing 77 distinct banking-specific intents with a total of 13,083 labeled utterances. It is one of three datasets used to evaluate the New Intent Discovery (NID) system implemented in this repository.
